patches.summary: Fix issue sync to use /rest/api/3/search/jql instead of /rest/api/3/issue/limit/report.
patches.reason: Generator picked the wrong list endpoint for the issue resource; the correct one is the JQL search endpoint.

patches.summary: Fix pagination for Jira JQL search (maxResults casing, nextPageToken cursor, --project flag).
patches.reason: Generator used generic pagination params; Jira JQL uses maxResults (camelCase) and nextPageToken cursor.

patches.summary: Add HTTP Basic auth support (JIRA_API_TOKEN + JIRA_EMAIL env vars).
patches.reason: Generator emitted OAuth2-only auth; Jira Cloud standard developer auth is HTTP Basic with email:token.

patches.summary: Fix live search fallback to use /rest/api/3/search/jql (old /rest/api/3/search returned 410).
patches.reason: Atlassian removed the old search endpoint; generator used the deprecated path.

patches.summary: Qualify ORDER BY rank as ORDER BY <table>_fts.rank in all FTS search queries.
patches.reason: dashboard table has a rank column that clashed with FTS5 rank pseudo-column.

patches.summary: Remove duplicate bodyLeadAccountId var declaration and lead-account-id flag registration in component create/update.
patches.reason: Generator emitted the same variable and flag twice, causing a runtime panic on --help.

patches.summary: Add cycle-time, workload, blocked, stale, worklog-summary, project-scoped sync, --type filters.
patches.reason: Hand-authored novel features not produced by generator.
